function onLoad(encoded_state)
    math.randomseed(os.time())
    state = JSON.decode(encoded_state)
    Wait.frames(function()
        if state ~= nil and state.numPie ~= nil then
            numPie = state.numPie
            self.UI.setAttribute('probMap', 'image', pieImageList[numPie])
        else
            numPie = 1
        end
    end, 20)
end

function onSave()
    return JSON.encode({numPie = numPie})
end

function tryObjectEnter()
    return false
end

function onFixedUpdate()
    if needlePower > 0 then
        local cps
        needleAngle = needleAngle + needlePower;
        if needleAngle >= 360.0 then
            needleAngle = needleAngle - 360.0;
        end
        self.UI.setAttribute('rlneedle', 'rotation', '0 0 '..tostring(needleAngle));
        cps = needlePower / 130
        needlePower = needlePower - cps - 0.03
        if needlePower <= 0 then -- end of spin
            local res = math.floor(needleAngle / 360.0 * numPie) + 1
            if spinner_color == nil or spinner_color == 'Black' then
                broadcastToAll("Spin Result: "..tostring(res).." ("..spinner_name..")", {0, 1, 1})
            else
                broadcastToAll("Spin Result: "..tostring(res).." ("..spinner_name..")", spinner_color)
            end
        end
    end
end

function rlSpinBtClick(player, value, id)
    if needlePower <= 0 then
        needleAngle = math.random(0, 3599) / 10
        needlePower = math.random(40, 75)
        spinner_name = player.steam_name
        spinner_color = player.color
    end
end

function rlSettingBtClick(player, value, id)
    player.showInputDialog("Enter the number of segments (2-100):", 
    function (text, player_color)
        local resnum = tonumber(text)
        if resnum == nil then
            return
        elseif resnum < 1 or resnum > 100 then
            player.showInfoDialog("Please enter a number between 2 and 100.")
            return
        else
            numPie = resnum
            onLoad(JSON.encode({numPie = numPie}))
        end
    end
    )
end
